title: Accessibility Statement
description: Our commitment to web accessibility and ensuring our website is usable by everyone.
wcag_description: Our website is designed to comply with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA, ensuring it is accessible to people with disabilities.
keyboard_desc: Our website is designed to be fully navigable using only a keyboard:
screen_reader_desc: We optimize our website for popular screen readers:
limitations_desc: While we strive for full accessibility, we are aware of some limitations:
third_party: Third-party widgets or embedded content may not be fully accessible. We are working with vendors to improve this.
animations: Some complex animations may be reduced for users who prefer reduced motion.
pdfs: Some PDF documents may not be fully accessible. We are working to make all PDFs accessible.
testing_desc: We regularly test our website using various methods:
feedback_desc: We welcome feedback on the accessibility of our website. If you encounter any accessibility barriers, please let us know:
what_to_include: What to Include in Your Feedback
web_page: The web page address where you encountered the issue
assistive_tech: The assistive technology you were using
preferred_format: Your preferred format for receiving information
legal_desc: We are committed to complying with accessibility laws and regulations:
eaa_desc: We comply with the European Accessibility Act, which requires that websites and mobile applications of private sector entities meet accessibility standards.
greek_law_desc: We comply with Greek law implementing the EAA, which sets accessibility requirements for products and services in Greece.
enforcement_desc: If you believe we have not complied with accessibility requirements, you may contact the Hellenic Data Protection Authority or other relevant enforcement bodies.
ongoing_desc: Accessibility is an ongoing commitment at adinfinity. We regularly review and improve our website to ensure it remains accessible to all users. This accessibility statement will be updated as we make improvements and as accessibility standards evolve.
assistance_desc: We're here to help you access our information and services.

widget.info_text: These settings help make our website more accessible for everyone.
